name: WebWork Time Tracker
description_en:
WebWork Time Tracker combines time/task recording with optional screenshots, app/site activity, attendance and financial-preparation reports. The vendor confirms WebWork, WebWork Tracker and WebWork Time Tracker refer to this product.

Desktop installation is required for broader device activity capture; a web dashboard alone does not establish that employee activity is being recorded. Collection modes, roles and approvals govern how reports should be interpreted.
description_zh:
WebWork Time Tracker 结合时间/任务记录、可选截图、应用/网站活动、考勤及财务准备报告。厂商确认 WebWork、WebWork Tracker 和 WebWork Time Tracker 指同一产品。

更广设备活动采集需安装桌面端，只有网页仪表板不证明员工活动已记录。采集模式、角色及审批决定报告如何解读。

core_features.explanation_en: Install the appropriate client to record time plus selected screenshot/app activity.
core_features.explanation_zh: 安装适当客户端，记录时间及所选截图/应用活动。

core_features.explanation_en: Plus adds manager timesheet approval to the base tracking offer.
core_features.explanation_zh: Plus 在基础追踪之上加入经理工时审批。

en: Create projects/tasks, invite members and install the tracker on the selected devices. Define screenshot mode and role access before collection. After an offline work interval, reconnect and compare source time, project allocation and approved totals rather than assuming every gap is idle work. No tracker or sync was executed.
zh: 创建项目/任务、邀请成员并安装所选设备的追踪器，采集前确定截图模式及角色访问。离线工作后重新连接，应核对来源时间、项目分配及已批总额，不能认定所有间隔都是闲置。本次未运行追踪或同步。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: reconcile an offline project session
sections.title_zh: 示例：核对离线项目工作
sections.en:
Create projects/tasks, invite members and install the tracker on the selected devices. Define screenshot mode and role access before collection. After an offline work interval, reconnect and compare source time, project allocation and approved totals rather than assuming every gap is idle work. No tracker or sync was executed.

A screenshot/activity signal should be reviewed with context and corrections before invoicing or payroll; it is not a complete quality or attendance judgment.
sections.zh:
创建项目/任务、邀请成员并安装所选设备的追踪器，采集前确定截图模式及角色访问。离线工作后重新连接，应核对来源时间、项目分配及已批总额，不能认定所有间隔都是闲置。本次未运行追踪或同步。

截图/活动信号应结合背景及更正后再用于发票或薪资，不是完整质量或考勤判断。

sections.title_en: Annual rates, approvals and AI credits
sections.title_zh: 年付费率、审批及 AI 额度
sections.en:
The annual-rate pricing view shows Pro $3.99, Plus $6.39 and Premium $7.19 per user monthly equivalent. The homepage separately states Pro monthly from $4.99 and annual from $3.99. Plus adds approvals; Premium adds unusual-activity detection and advanced provisioning/security. Custom contracts are quoted.

AI assistant use has monthly credit pools of ten/twenty-five/fifty in the compared tiers, so an AI feature label is not unlimited usage. Confirm cadence, taxes, seats and credit exhaustion behavior. A fourteen-day no-card trial is not a sustained free plan.
sections.zh:
年付费率视图显示 Pro 每用户月均 $3.99、Plus $6.39、Premium $7.19。首页另明确 Pro 月付 $4.99 起、年付 $3.99 起。Plus 加审批，Premium 加异常活动检测及高级配置/安全，定制合同询价。

比较表中 AI 助手每月额度分别十/二十五/五十，AI 标签不代表无限使用。需确认周期、税费、席位及额度耗尽行为。十四天无需卡试用不是永久免费档。

sections.title_en: A report is not a completed financial transfer
sections.title_zh: 报告不等于财务传输已完成
sections.en:
Distributed project teams can evaluate tracking-to-approval workflows. Set edit/approval ownership, privacy/retention policy and export mapping before rollout. Reconcile the original batch after a failed payment/invoice integration rather than repeatedly sending the same totals.

No unusual-activity accuracy, device monitoring, permissions, payroll/payment, software licence, self-hosted deployment or restoration was verified. Vendor security/uptime badges remain statements rather than tests in this profile.
sections.zh:
分布式项目团队可评估追踪到审批流程，上线前明确编辑/审批责任、隐私/保留政策及导出映射。付款/发票集成失败后应核对原批次，不要反复发送相同总额。

未核实异常活动准确性、设备监测、权限、薪资/付款、软件许可、自托管部署或恢复。厂商安全/正常运行徽章属于陈述，不是本文实测。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: No monitoring, offline sync, classification, financial transfer, licence, permissions or restore tested; final tax/currency requires checkout.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试监测、离线同步、分类、财务传输、许可、权限或恢复；最终税费/货币需结算核对。
